description: This file defines a ProductQuery class that provides an API for querying products from a database, with support for filtering, searching, and integrating website-specific product information. It is part of a shopping cart or e-commerce module within the larger project, specifically related to product listing and search functionality.

classes.name: ProductQuery
classes.description: A class that provides methods to perform product searches and filtering in an e-commerce setting, supporting features like attribute filtering, search term matching, and website-specific product group considerations.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the ProductQuery instance with default settings, including product page length, fields, and base filters.

methods.name: query(self, attributes=None, fields=None, search_term=None, start=0, item_group=None)
methods.description: Performs a product search with optional attribute filters, field filters, search term, pagination start, and item group filtering. Returns a sorted list of product items with additional product info.

methods.name: build_fields_filters(self, filters)
methods.description: Constructs internal filters based on specified field values, handling multi-select fields appropriately.

methods.name: build_search_filters(self, search_term)
methods.description: Creates search filters based on the search term across predefined and meta-defined searchable fields.
